In your opinion, what are the best and worst video game HD remakes?

The recent Zelda ones seem pretty damn good. The fact they have actual new content and features helps a lot, as does the slightly remixed music and often quite significantly upgraded graphics.

Not sure about worst though.
The worst HD rereleases I've seen were when the first two God of War titles were ported to the PS3. Polygons so damned sharp I wondered why Kratos bothered with swords at all.

Best -

  • STALKER 2009, because it looks beautiful and sounds even better. The bug fixes are just icing.
  • Soldier of Fortune Community, because the original SoF was one of Raven Software's best run and gun games of last decade.

Worst -

  • Silent Hill HD, because they forgot to reprogram the fog system to hide the loading textures, among other things.
  • Ratchet and Clank, because the devs completely forgot what made Ratchet so fun, and rounded, as a character in the first place.

Wind Waker HD is good. Many new features were added that weren't possible on the GameCube. Rayman Legends also included ported levels from Rayman Origins, and is a quality remake. Worst (for me) would be Half Life: Source, as it simply adds rag doll physics while scrapping multiplayer; it simply doesn't add anything.
The best HD remakes imo were shut down by the owners of the original IP. Worst HD remake of recent years I would say is The Last of Us HD.
Yeah, RIP Chrono Resurrection...fuck you Square Enix
Shadow of the Colossus/Ico Ps3 remaster looked really good in my opinion, Age of Empires 2 HD remaster also looked good.
Worst: The Conkers Bad Fur Day remake for the Xbox 360. Campaign was great but the multiplayer was a shell of its former self. All they had to do to make it perfect was copy the multiplayer too.
Perfect Dark for Xbox Live Arcade was great!

Best: Majoras Mask 3D, I was never a big fan of the original, but for some reason the remake really helped the game grow on me more.

Worst: Final Fantasy 7, judging from the previews they scrapped the classic turn based combat in favor of the brain dead FF13 battle system, and it has shitty voice acting.
